courses.title: Full-Stack Web Development Bootcamp
courses.description: Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and Node.js from scratch. This comprehensive bootcamp takes you from beginner to job-ready full-stack developer with hands-on projects and real-world applications.
courses.shortDescription: Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and Node.js from scratch.

courses.title: Advanced React Patterns
courses.description: Dive deep into React hooks, context, and performance optimization. Master advanced patterns like compound components, render props, and custom hooks to build scalable applications.
courses.shortDescription: Dive deep into React hooks, context, and performance optimization.

courses.title: Building RESTful APIs with Express
courses.description: Master API design using Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. Learn authentication, validation, error handling, and deployment best practices for production-ready APIs.
courses.shortDescription: Master API design using Node.js, Express, and MongoDB.

courses.title: Introduction to Machine Learning
courses.description: Get started with supervised and unsupervised learning techniques. Explore algorithms like linear regression, decision trees, k-means clustering, and neural networks with Python and scikit-learn.
courses.shortDescription: Get started with supervised and unsupervised learning techniques.

courses.title: Deep Learning with TensorFlow
courses.description: Train deep neural networks using TensorFlow and Keras. Build convolutional neural networks for image recognition and recurrent networks for sequence prediction tasks.
courses.shortDescription: Train deep neural networks using TensorFlow and Keras.

courses.title: Natural Language Processing (NLP) Fundamentals
courses.description: Learn the basics of text data, tokenization, and model building. Work with word embeddings, sentiment analysis, named entity recognition, and transformer models.
courses.shortDescription: Learn the basics of text data, tokenization, and model building.

courses.title: Computation Models and Turing Machines
courses.description: Understand computation models including finite automata and Turing machines. Explore the theoretical foundations of computer science and what makes problems computable.
courses.shortDescription: Understand computation models including finite automata and Turing machines.

courses.title: Complexity Theory Essentials
courses.description: Learn P, NP, NP-Complete, and NP-Hard concepts with examples. Understand computational complexity, reduction techniques, and the famous P vs NP problem.
courses.shortDescription: Learn P, NP, NP-Complete, and NP-Hard concepts with examples.

courses.title: Formal Languages and Automata
courses.description: Dive into grammars, languages, and pushdown automata. Study regular expressions, context-free grammars, and the Chomsky hierarchy of formal languages.
courses.shortDescription: Dive into grammars, languages, and pushdown automata.
